handbookNote: Source: Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual, official PDF from the Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security (www.tn.gov/content/dam/tn/safety/documents/DL_Manual.pdf, linked from tn.gov/safety/driver-services/helpful-information/formspublications.html), current-as-of-July-1-2022 edition, 135 pages, fetched and OCR'd in full for this build -- saved to temp/handbooks/tn/driver.txt. Real exam mechanics found in the manual itself (Section A-4, The Examinations): the knowledge test is a multiple-choice computerized test covering four roughly equal areas -- traffic signs and signals (25%), safe driving principles (25%), rules of the road (25%), and drugs and alcohol (25%, this split is explicitly mandated by law per the manual's Section B-7 note). A 1-day mandatory wait applies after any knowledge-test failure. The manual does NOT publish an exact total item count, an exact numeric passing score/percentage, or a time limit anywhere in its text -- confirmed by full-text search of the manual plus WebFetch of tn.gov/safety/driver-services/classd/new-drivers.html and .../classd/teengdl.html, neither of which states these numbers either. Those two specific figures (item count, pass score) are therefore left unconfirmed rather than guessed, per project instructions -- only the confirmed 25/25/25/25 topic-weighting and the 1-day retest wait are used as grounded exam-mechanics facts. Content-depth rationale: the manual is unusually rich and Tennessee-specific (135 pages covering licensing/GDL, signs and signals, rules of the road, DUI/alcohol with a full penalty and BAC table, seatbelt/child-restraint law, interstate driving, night/weather driving, driver responsibility/points table, defensive driving, and a full 'sharing the road' chapter for pedestrians/bicycles/motorcycles/trucks/trains/farm equipment/work zones), which comfortably supports a 250-300 question pool of distinct, well-grounded questions across 15 topic buckets without padding or invented facts; final pool size determined by build-time dedup.
